Drillmaster is set up and issue #1 is started. I stopped after `work_status`, as you asked.

**Setup**
- Workflow `0.0.0` is in the Drillmaster repository. It holds only the objective "ship features without Owner stepping in" and the measure `owner_corrections_per_item`.
- The first setup attempt failed because Drillmaster's git couldn't read the `/c/Users/...` form of the path. It worked with the Windows form of the same repository, `/home/user/.claude/jobs/7f73c306/tmp/rec3/drillmaster.git`, and that is the path `.drillmaster` stores.
- `.drillmaster` is in the work folder (repository plus folder `project`) but I haven't committed it yet. It needs to be committed with the project so Drillmaster recognises this folder on other machines. I can do that when you want; you're on `master`, so I'd make a branch first.

**Issue #1 "add a CONTRIBUTING.md"**
- `work_start` created work item `wi_f26ab60d` on workflow 0.0.0.
- **"Only for this session" isn't in effect.** That would mean limiting the session to certain work stages, but workflow 0.0.0 has none yet, so `work_start` ran without that limit. `work_status` shows the session covers "every stage", which right now means no checkpoints or review gates at all.
- `work_status` shows the item active with no stage, step or pending gate. It has recorded 2 traces and has 0 reports and 0 rejections.

**From here on:**
- Give me issues as usual. I start each one with `work_start` and report as I go, and every action is recorded.
- Correct me whenever I get something wrong. The workflow is built from your corrections.
- Run `/devops-drillmaster:retrospective` when you want the workflow to improve.

When you say so, I'll write CONTRIBUTING.md and deliver it with `work_deliver`.
